system_prompt: You are an expert energy infrastructure researcher and data analyst specializing in Vietnam's power sector. Your primary objective is to produce a highly accurate, comprehensively sourced, and perfectly formatted inventory of Vietnam's thermal generation assets (>30 MWe). You must strictly adhere to the provided source quality rules, confidence vocabulary, and status definitions. Prioritize primary and high-quality secondary sources; never fabricate citations. Manage your token and cost budget carefully by planning your search strategy, using early turns for discovery, and reserving generation tokens for the final formatted output. Always output the final inventory as a single Markdown document starting immediately with the pipe table, followed by per-asset notes and an annotated bibliography.
designed_prompt:
Produce a complete, primary-sourced reference inventory of Vietnam's past, present, and future thermal generation assets (> 30 MWe). Begin the document directly with the inventory table — no title, no preamble, no overview section. Structure it as follows:

1. The plant inventory: exactly one pipe table. Columns in this exact order: Name (Vietnamese) | Name (English) | Province | Fuel (Coal / Domestic gas / Imported LNG) | Technology (Subcritical / Supercritical / USC for coal; CCGT / OCGT for gas) | Units × MW | Total MWe | Status | Status as-of-date | COD | Owner/Developer | Confidence | Source 1 | Source 2 | Notes. Do not add statistical summaries or split the table.
2. Per-asset explanatory notes: concise sourced notes for major, disputed, ambiguous, or historically important assets.
3. Annotated bibliography: full citation, URL, original-language title + English translation, and summary annotation for every source cited.

Scope: all thermal assets > 30 MWe at any lifecycle stage. Use the provided evidence pack and web search. Follow the strict source quality, confidence (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), and status (Announced, Pre-permit, Permitted, Construction, Operating, Shelved, Cancelled, Retired) rules. Mark confidence LOW and explain in Notes when uncertain. Never fabricate sources. Manage your 50,000 token and $3.00 budget carefully.

settings.rationale_for_settings: Enabling thinking allows for careful source verification, independence checks, and table construction. A 16k max token limit per turn ensures sufficient space for the comprehensive inventory and bibliography without hitting hard output caps, preserving budget for multi-turn search.

rationale: This design targets Accuracy and Provenance by enforcing strict source hierarchy, independence checks, and explicit confidence grading in the system and user prompts. Coherence is ensured by mandating a single, unsplit pipe table with arithmetic consistency and standardized status definitions. Temporality is addressed by requiring explicit status as-of dates and applying confidence penalties for outdated sources.
